title: Roof Replacement in Eagle Creek, OR
summary: In June 2025, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Eagle Creek, OR. The crew tore the old shingles off down to the deck, cut out rotten sheathing and put in new plywood, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles over synthetic underlayment, with new flashings, ridge cap and pipe boots.
scope: Tore off the old shingles down to the roof deck
Replaced rotten roof sheathing with new plywood
Laid Safeguard 30 synthetic underlayment over the deck
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with new drip edge, wall flashing, ridge cap and pipe boots
Cleaned up and ran a magnet over the yard for nails
body: The old roof had moss working into the shingle seams and around the pipe flashings. Once the shingles came off, some of the sheathing underneath was rotten, so the crew cut those sections out and laid in new plywood before the underlayment went down. The photos follow the job from the old roof to the new deck, all wrapped up and ready for shingles.

faqs.question: What happens if there's rotten wood under the old shingles?
faqs.answer: On this Eagle Creek job, the crew found rotten sheathing once the old shingles were off. They cut it out and replaced it with new plywood, so the new underlayment and shingles went down on a solid deck.

faqs.question: What shingles were installed?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles, over Safeguard 30 synthetic underlayment.
